item.title: EplayerX 1.2.50
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 媒体库新增「纠正目录」，可调整影片和剧集的目录归属。 - 改进剧集季数、集数识别与匹配，提高媒体库整理准确性。 - 优化首页继续观看的影片信息刷新。 - 修复字幕服务设置中的未保存提示，以及播放引擎切换后的画中画可用状态。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Added Correct Directory to change which library directory a movie or series belongs to. - Improved season and episode recognition and matching for more accurate library organization. - Improved metadata refresh for Continue Watching on the home screen. - Fixed unsaved-change messages in subtitle service settings and Picture in Picture availability after switching playback engines.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
